skills.name: Fox Whispers (狐言)
skills.line: If you wish to have a taste of despair, I'd be happy to help.
skills.description: Kuzunoha attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Spirit Crossing (渡灵)
skills.line: Bestow upon you the Mark of the Fox-from now on, you're one of mine.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. When Kuzunoha uses a skill other than Origin Art, gains 1 stack of Nine-Tailed Power. ;Upon Usage :She gains 1 stack of Nine-Tailed Power, and grants an allied target 3 stacks of Kitsune Protection, lasts for 1 turn. ;Nine-Tailed Power (九尾之力) : :'''General, Mark''': Max 3 stacks, When carried, unlocks Origin Art, allowing the transfiguration of allied units equal to the number of stacks. ;Kitsune Protection (狐族庇佑) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max 3 stacks. Immune to 1 instance of damage, control effects or banish. Removes 1 stack after immunity. ; :

upgrades.text: Grants an ally 3 stack of Kitsune Protection.
When an ally gains Kitsune Protection, increases Kuzunoha's SPD by 75 (up to 3 times), lasting for 1 turn.
When cast, grants herself 1 stack of Kitsune Protection for 1 turn.
At the start of battle, gains 1 stack of Kitsune Protection, lasting 1 turn.

skills.name: Origin Art (归源术)
skills.description: Exclusive effect. Kuzunoha selects an allied shikigami to remove all their debuffs, and grant them the Transfiguration effect, merging with them into Great Spirit Form and gaining a new turn; or select an allied shikigami to remove the Transfiguration effect. ;Transfiguration (幻化) :Protected by Kuzunoha, increasing her SPD by 15%. Unable to act, cannot be targeted, and Move Bar position locked; immune to damage, healing, buffs, and debuffs. ;Great Spirit Form (大妖姿态) : :HP equals to 225% of Kuzunoha's starting ATK. When HP is above 50%, immune to debuffs and Banish. Gains orbs equal to the number of transfigured units before action. Removes all statuses and marks except Nine-Tailed Power, replaces Fox Shadow Array with Finale: Sky Blast. Returns to normal form upon receiving lethal damage or when all transfigured shikigami have their Transfiguration removed.

upgrades.text: For each shikigami transfigured, increases the Great Spirit Form's HP by 20%.
For each shikigami transfigured, increases the Great Spirit Form's ATK by 20%.
For each shikigami transfigured, increases the Great Spirit Form's DEF by 20%.
For each shikigami transfigured, increases the Great Spirit Form's CRIT DMG by 10%.

skills.name: Fox Shadow Array (狐影阵)
skills.line: Before any sparks of trouble touch my child, I'll burn down the source of the problem!
skills.description: Kuzunoha uses fox spirit sorcery to attack all enemies, dealing damage equal to 180% of her ATK.

bio.condition: Team Kuzunoha with another player’s Seimei and clear any zone 20 times.
